exposure: etiology of APIP (acute biliary pancreatitis, hyperlipidemic pancreatitis, other etiologies)
severity of APIP (mild, moderately severe, severe)
cohort: The study included 54 pregnant women diagnosed with acute pancreatitis in pregnancy (APIP) who were treated at two tertiary clinical centers over a 6-year period.
finding: The incidence of preterm delivery, fetal distress, and fetal loss increased with the progression of APIP severity, with hyperlipidemic pancreatitis (HLP) being more likely to lead to worse fetal outcomes.
